rules.statement: The benefit of priority by registration accrues to a subsequent Deed for valuable consideration as against an earlier deed from the same source which is either not registered or not duly registered.
rules.supporting_quote: It is settled law that the benefit of priority by registration accrues to a subsequent Deed for valuable consideration as against an earlier deed from the same source which is either not registered or not duly registered.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 14 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance, No. 23 of 1927 as amended subsequently
